calculation.expression: when lagged VIX daily return exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile, -(asset_3d_return - cross_sectional_median_3d_return); otherwise inactive
calculation.description: On dates following an unusually large VIX increase, rank the negative three-day asset return residual versus the cross-sectional median. The signal is computed using data through the prior completed day and is inactive outside shock dates.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was negative in 2020-2022 (-0.0362; 32 observations) but positive in 2023-2024 (+0.0933; 29), 2025-2026 (+0.0824; 39), and 2027 year-to-date (+0.1138; 7). Sparse conditional activation means uncertainty is material.
